name: liquid-gradient
blurb: Animated gradient blob breathing and morphing on hover.
description: Layered SVG gradients with Framer Motion animation. Cycles through transform sequences; animation slows on hover (50s cycle) and speeds up on blur (10s cycle).
use_when: A hero background or visual feature where motion should respond to user attention without being distracting.
avoid_when: Prefers-reduced-motion users; no skip flag. Expensive for multiple instances; large screens (1030px SVG × 7 layers).
a11y: No focus or keyboard handling. Ignores prefers-reduced-motion; animation always runs.
